user.title: Set up HealthSync
user.description: A webhook URL will be generated for the HealthSync iOS app. After setup, a notification shows the URL to paste into the app (Settings → Home Assistant).

data_description.name: Appears in the name of every device and entity of this entry. Leave blank for a single-person setup.
data_description.secret: If set, payloads without this secret are rejected. Enter the same value in the app's Settings.
